items.title: Meet Code Reviewer, now available with Jira
items.summary: Get a fast, useful first review on every pull request. Code Reviewer is generally available with paid Jira and Teamwork Collection licenses. As teams adopt AI coding agents, they’re writing code faster and in greater volume.
